info.title: kanbot API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up and serving HTTP.

Readiness: the database is reachable and every migration has been
applied. Until `kanbot-backend migrate` has run, the old schema is in
place and requests could fail, so the instance takes no traffic.

503.description: Not ready: the database is unreachable or migrations are pending.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine-readable error codes. Clients depend on these strings:
add new codes, but never rename or reuse one.

FieldError.description: One invalid field of a request.

code.description:
Why it is invalid, as a stable `snake_case` code (`too_long`,
`required`, ...). Never the invalid value itself.

pointer.description:
JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the field in the request body, for example
`/title` or `/labels/2`.

Problem.description:
A problem details body (RFC 9457), with the `code` and `errors`
extension members.

errors.description: The invalid fields of a `validation_failed` problem.

status.description: Always the status of the response that carries the problem.

trace_id.description:
The W3C trace id of the request (32 hex digits), when telemetry is
on. Lets support find the request's trace and logs.
